name: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell
description: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell is a singleplayer third-person stealth action game and the first in the Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell series.

steam.patches: The community patched Enhanced Splinter Cell fixes bugs and provides additional game improvements.

gog.patches: The community patched Enhanced Splinter Cell fixes bugs and provides additional game improvements.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX
audio_settings.reason: Splinter Cell ships with EAX and hardware 3D sound off.

optional_settings.title: Enable volumetric lighting, 32-bit and detail textures
optional_settings.reason: These three graphics options are set to True in the config files.

optional_settings.title: Raise shadow, light map and texture quality to max
optional_settings.reason: The game sets shadow, light map and texture detail below the maximum by default. This entry sets all three to level 3 in SplinterCellUser.ini.

optional_settings.title: Enable anti-aliasing
optional_settings.reason: The change sets AntiAliasing to 2 in SplinterCellUser.ini under Engine.EPCGameOptions. The game is likely to start with anti-aliasing off or lower, so edges look jagged.

optional_settings.title: Fix character models by turning off HardwareSkinning
optional_settings.reason: Out of the box, the game may use the GPU to animate character models through the D3D renderer. This setting turns that off, so the CPU does it.
